root_cause.text: The function `mlx5e_ipsec_disable_events` dereferences the `ipsec` pointer of a peer private data structure (`peer_priv->ipsec`) without checking if it is NULL, which occurs when the peer device does not support IPsec.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that the condition `if (peer_priv)` is updated to `if (peer_priv && peer_priv->ipsec)` before attempting to access `peer_priv->ipsec->comp` in `complete_all()`. This is supported by the crash log showing a kernel NULL pointer dereference at address `00000000000000a0` (the offset of `comp` within the NULL `ipsec` structure) inside `mlx5e_ipsec_disable_events`.
